notes.summary: Adds missing Tama Mike Portnoy Melody Master MP1455 maple snare record. MusicPlayers.com review confirms standard MP1455 is a 5.5x14 maple shell with black finish, die-cast chrome hoops, MSL-SCT chrome lugs, MCS100A three-way tension adjustable snare strainer, Remo Coated Ambassador batter, and Remo Clear Ambassador snare-side.

notes.scoringBasis: MusicPlayers.com review confirms MP1455 standard Melody Master is the 5.5x14 maple shell model with semi-gloss black covering, die-cast chrome hoops, Tama MSL-SCT chrome lugs, MCS100A three-way tension adjustable snare strainer, Remo Coated Ambassador batter, and Remo Clear Ambassador snare-side. Shell thickness, bearing edge, snare bed, and stock snare wires remain unconfirmed.
